魔大戰……那是一場燒盡萬物的戰爭，當戰爭結束之時，名為「魔法」的力量從世上消失了。
千年之後，人類利用機械的力量使世界復甦，而這時，一名生來就擁有魔導之力的少女出現了。

藉由能夠習得能力、魔法以及召喚的「魔石系統」，能夠使玩家按自己的喜好來培養角色。
主要角色均為主人公。他們懷有著各種目的，而他們的命運又相互交錯編織成了這一群像劇。
作為當時FF系列的巔峰之作，本作至今都享有極高的人氣。

---------------------------------------------

■以嶄新的畫質與音質完美復活！
・創造出代表《FF》的點陣角色的澀谷員子也加入進重製隊伍之中，所有的畫面都以鮮活的2D得以重現。
・為《FF》的世界注入生命的諸多名曲，也都在作曲者植松伸夫先生的完全監修之下獲得改編。
・劇中的歌劇場景增加了新的表演與展示，並新收錄了演唱版的樂曲。

■更加輕鬆地體驗遊戲！
・複刻版搭載了經過全面改良的UI系統、自動戰鬥與自動保存功能，方便玩家能更加愉悅地體驗遊戲。
・還追加了怪物圖鑑、畫廊和音樂播放器等能夠更進一步享受遊戲世界的要素。
・BGM音源可以在本作的「改編」設定和原作的「原版」設定中進行切換。
・追加了「遇敵開關」、「獲得經驗值0~4倍」和「魔法習得值0~4倍」等功能，大幅增加了遊戲的趣味性。

※本作為以1994年發售的原版《FINAL FANTASY VI》為基礎開發的複刻版。不包含一部分其他重製版中變更、追加的要素。
※另有販售包含本商品的套組商品。請注意避免重複購買。

Tsifrovoy mir v otchayanii! Mashinodramony seyut khaos povsyudu! Digi-izbrannym, vklyuchaya vas, predstoit vosstanovit mirovoy poryadok v Digimon World: Next Order — rolevoy igre pro sbor monstrov.

Naydite i zaverbuyte kak mozhno bolshe vernykh digimonov, chtoby vosstanovit Tsifrovoy mir. Smozhete li vy sovmestit obuchenie s issledovaniem i pomeshat zarazhennomu virusom digimonu unichtozhit vse vokrug?

Vyberite geroya muzhskogo ili zhenskogo pola i poprobuyte sobrat bolee dvukhsot digimonov! Vpervye vy mozhete issledovat mir s DVUMYa digimonami-kompanonami srazu!

Postaraytes podruzhitsya s digimonami! Kormite ikh, treniruyte i razvivayte. Chem krepche svyaz mezhdu vami i vashim digimonom, a takzhe mezhdu dvumya digimonami-kompanonami, tem bolshe shansov na pobedu v bitvakh!

Upravlyayte Floatiey i razvivayte svoy gorod! Ishchite novykh digimonov, uluchshayte zdaniya, rastite urozhay i sozdavayte protsvetayushchiy megapolis!

Obuchayte paru digimonov, chtoby oni soobshcha srazhalis protiv II! Otdavayte prikazy i podbadrivayte ikh!

zh_hans.title: Chaos Head Noah / Chaos Child [NSP][ENG]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + uluchshennyy angloperevod 来自 Committee Of Zero
zh_hans.description:
Takumi Nishijo is a second-year high school student on the verge of becoming a shut-in.
“I have no interest in 3D.” He lives surrounded by his beautiful girl figures in his room.
He lives in Shibuya, where there has been a series of bizarre serial murders known as “New Generation Madness” (aka NewGen).
The culprit has yet to be caught and has been causing unrest on the internet and television.
One day, a gruesome image that seemed to predict the next NewGen killing was sent by a mysterious figure called “Shogun.”
The next day, on his way home from school, Takumi encounters a horrific crime scene, exactly as predicted.
Before the corpse is a blood-soaked girl – Rimi Sakihata.

zh_hans.title: Digimon Survive + 6 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
Vizualnaya novella s elementami takticheskoy rolevoy igry: Takuma Momodzuka, Minoru Khinata, Aoy Sibuya, Saki Kimisima, Ryo Tominaga, Syudzi Kayama, Kayto, Miu Shinonome i drugie vo vremya vesennikh kanikul otpravlyayutsya v Lager Istoricheskikh Issledovaniy. Na vtoroy den Takuma, Minoru i Aoy poseshchayut mestnyy izvestnyy khram, chtoby issledovat legendu o «bogakh-zveryakh» (Kemonogami), gde vskore sostoitsya festival v ikh chest.
Vo vremya issledovaniya, oni natykayutsya na Koromona, a zatem slyshat strannye kriki. I imenno v etot moment Takuma s druzyami obnaruzhivayut, chto nakhodyatsya v sovershenno inom mire..
Neskolko prokhozhdeniy mogut privesti k raznym putyam i raznym digivolyutsiyam. V igre est neskolko kontsovok, igra razdelena na neskolko tipov igrovogo protsessa, takikh kak «Dramaticheskoe deystvo», «Poiskovye zadachi», «Frirayd» i «Svobodnye bitvy»!Drugie igry Digimon.

zh_hans.title: Hack G.U. Last Recode (Rebirth, Reminisce, Redemption, Reconnection) [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
Uzhe pervaya igra v .hack//G.U. Last Recode — Vol. 1: Rebirth, sumela ne na shutku udivit kachestvom prorabotki svoego mira. Komanda CyberConnect2 iznachalno zadumala sdelat bolshuyu franshizu, razdelyonnuyu na neskolko igr, i reshala: «Esli uzh brat igrokov masshtabom, tak po polnoy programme». V rezultate, pomimo «virtualnoy» offlayn-MMO, v ramkakh kotoroy razvivayutsya osnovnye igrovye sobytiya, nas privetstvuet virt glavnogo geroya — rabochiy stol ego kompyutera, lichnyy pochtovyy yashchik, novostnye sayty i forumy. Prichyom eto ne dekoratsii, kak v nekotorykh sovremennykh igrakh, sushchestvuyushchie prosto dlya galochki, a zhivaya i postepenno napolnyayushchayasya informatsiey ekosistema, deystvuyushchaya po sovremennym printsipam vsemirnoy pautiny.
Sobytiya .hack rasskazyvayut nam o parne po imeni Khaseo, poklonnike novoy setevoy MMO The World. Nachav igrat, on sumel dostich nemalykh vysot, a zatem sluchilas strashnaya beda — odna iz nemnogikh ego podrug po igre, devushka po imeni Sino, podverglas napadeniyu drugogo igroka i vpala v komu. V nastoyashchuyu komu. Kak okazalos, etot sluchay ne edinichnyy, no kompaniya CyberConnect2 ne speshit predavat stol shchepetilnye dela oglaske. Sobravshis s silami, Khaseo reshaet nayti tainstvennogo ubiytsu i raspravitsya s nim. Vsego-to nuzhno stat uzhasom, letyashchim na krylyakh nochi i porazhayushchim ubiytsu za ubiytsey — tekh igrokov, kotorye prikhodyat s tselyu pookhotitsya ne na monstrov i NPC, a na personazhey drugikh igrokov — poka ne doberyotsya do samogo mogushchestvennogo i tainstvennogo iz nikh, Tray-Edzha..
Voydite v lyubimye miry snova! Izdanie Last Recode dlya Nintendo Switch vklyuchaet v sebya vse 4 chasti:

zh_hans.title: Elasto Mania Remastered / ElastoMania 2 [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
THE QUIRKY SECOND CHAPTER

Elasto Mania II was released in 2017 as a successor to cult classic Elasto Mania (commonly known as Elma) and Action SuperCross. The long-awaited sequel is still a 2D enduro simulator with a nostalgic feel, but it’s also about giving you more bang for your buck than ever, with more challenges, extra collectibles, updated physics and new graphics.

TAKE IT EASY OR TAKE IT TO THE NEXT LEVEL

Will you sit back and enjoy a quick game between two conference calls? Or will you challenge yourself at 2 A.M. until you see your name on top? Wherever you want to go, Elasto Mania II will take you there.

zh_hans.title: Murder House, Nun Massacre (Night of the Nun), Bloodwash, Stay Out of the House, Night at the Gates of Hell, Cannibal Abduction, The Night of the Scissors, The Glass Staircase, Beastwatch Meat and Mayhem, Rewind or Die - Puppet Combo collection [NSZ][RUS/Multi]
zh_hans.developer: Puppet Combo (Pig Farmer Games, Benedetto 'Ben' Cocuzza)
zh_hans.interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
zh_hans.description:
80-ye s dukhom starykh dobrykh VHS-kasset vozvrashchayutsya!
..V popytke snyat skandalnuyu dokumentalku pro prizrakov, novostnaya semochnaya gruppa pronikaet v staryy zabroshennyy dom, v kotorom kogda-to zhil pozzhe kaznennyy seriynyy ubiytsa Entoni Smit. No na samom li dele pechalno izvestnyy Paskhalnyy potroshitel mertv, ili zhe on prosto podzhidaet novykh zhertv, chtoby vyrezat ikh odnu za odnoy? Kto vyzhivet v etom krovavom karnavale?
Curvayvl-khorror konsoley pyatogo pokoleniya: v ney tankovoe upravlenie, fiksirovannye ugly kamery, i esli vam ne nravitsya tankovoe upravlenie, to i eta igra vam ne ponravitsya. V igre takzhe net avtosokhraniya (tolko s pomoshchyu ogranichennogo kolichestva karandashey).Eshchyo lou-poli 3D igr, pokhozhikh na epokhu PS1-PSX.

zh_hans.title: Dynasty Warriors 9 Empires (Shin Sangoku Musou 8 Empires) + 25 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
Novyy reliz iz serii Empires, kotoryy darit polzovatelyam kak azart boya odin na tysyachu, tak i slozhnyy simulyator zavoevaniya strany!

Osobennosti DYNASTY WARRIORS 9 Empires
■ Komanduyte svoimi armiyami v svobodnom rezhime! Osazhdayte zamki (Castle Sieges)!
Boevaya sistema izmenilas: vmesto «Boev» (Battles) iz predydushchikh versiy poyavilis «Osady zamka» (Castle Sieges), kotorye proiskhodyat ryadom s zamkom. Situatsiya postoyanno menyaetsya, tak chto vam potrebuetsya mnogo voysk i strategicheskoe myshlenie, chtoby vyigrat v boyu novogo tipa i otvetit na glavnyy vopros – kak zhe zakhvatit etot zamok?

■ Politicheskaya (Politics) sistema, gde na silu strany vliyayut lichnye kachestva i nadezhnost ofitsera (Officer).
Rasklad sil opredelyaetsya vashim vyborom i vzaimodeystviem mezhdu ofitserami (Officers). Vy smozhete igrat za praviteley (Rulers), generalov (Generals), nezavisimykh ofitserov (Unaffiliated Officers) i drugikh personazhey. Ikh vzaimodeystvie s drug drugom mozhet ukrepit ikh rodnuyu stranu.

■ Zhivite aktivno! Uluchshennyy rezhim redaktury (Edit Mode).
V etoy igre est rezhim Edit Mode, lyubimyy vsemi igrokami. Sozdavayte polzovatelskikh ofitserov (Custom Officers), menyaya samye raznye elementy.
94 muso-ofitsera (Musou Officers) i bolee 700 obychnykh ofitserov (Generic Officers) pozvolyat vam polnostyu izmenit naselenie mira DYNASTY WARRIORS 9.

Primechanie: izdanie DYNASTY WARRIORS 9 Empires Deluxe Edition takzhe est v prodazhe. Pri pokupke obyazatelno proverte vybrannyy tovar.

zh_hans.title: 一起五子棋 [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
一起五子棋是一款兩人對弈的純策略型棋類遊戲。其規則簡單，先在橫、直或斜對角線上形成5子連線者獲勝。

zh_hans.title: Reknum Cheri Dreamland [NSP][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
REKNUM Fantasy of Dreams - eto igra v zhanre ekshn, priklyucheniya i 2D platformer.
poslednyaya chast sagi REKNUM, v kotoroy Cheri probuzhdaetsya ot fantazii, chtoby nachat nastoyashchee priklyuchenie!
Issleduyte tematicheskie urovni, otkryvayte novoe oruzhie i uluchshayte svoi navyki, srazhaytes s groznymi bossami, vdokhnovlennymi klassicheskim igrovym protsessom, rasshifruyte poeticheskie slova predkov, puteshestvuya po miru snov, i dostignite nastoyashchego konechnogo rezultata.

zh_hans.title: Strange Brigade + 10 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
zh_hans.description:
Stertaya iz pamyati chelovechestva i pogrebennaya v bezymyannoy grobnitse na 4 000 let, koroleva vedm Seteki vnov vernulas.
Tolko odin otryad geroev mozhet protivostoyat Seteki i ee armii mumifitsirovannykh monstrov: Strannaya brigada!

ZAKhVATYVAYuShchEE PRIKLYuChENIE — Golovokruzhitelnaya kampaniya s mnozhestvom protivnikov, kotorykh vy otpravite obratno v ad. Igrayte v odinochku ili v kompanii iz 2-4 druzey v kooperative onlayn i po lokalnoy seti.

BESSTRAShNYE OKhOTNIKI ZA SOKROVIShchAMI — Otpravtes v priklyuchenie vmeste s tremya drugimi bravymi agentami, natrenirovannymi v bitvakh so sverkhestestvennym. Tseltes i strelyayte iz moshchnogo oruzhiya s pomoshchyu dzhoystika, i vysvobozhdayte silu magicheskikh amuletov!

ZLOBNYE MONSTRY — stonushchie mumii, ognedyshashchie ubiytsy, pokrytye latami minotavry i drugoe otrode, gorazdo khuzhe etogo!

UZhASNYE LOVUShKI — Obezglavlivayte nezhit krutyashchimisya lezviyami, podzharivayte ikh do khrustyashchey korochki s pomoshchyu ognennykh lovushek i ne tolko. Vy zhe ne budete ikh stavit dlya svoikh soyuznikov... pravda?

NEURYaDITsY S GOLOVOLOMKAMI — Vsegda smotrite v oba i ishchite podozritelnye podskazki, sekretnye prokhody i drevnie prisposobleniya! Kto znaet, kakie sokrovishcha vas mogut zhdat...

zh_hans.title: Catan + DLC [NSP][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
Torguyte, stroyte i sozdavayte poseleniya na Nintendo Switch™! 
Otkroyte dlya sebya vse vesele strategicheski-sotsialnoy nastolnoy igry, polyubivsheysya millionam! 

Ostrov CATAN™ — neobitaemaya zemlya, bogataya resursami, kotoraya tak i zhdet, kogda vy na ney poselites. K sozhaleniyu, vashi soperniki tozhe pretenduyut na etot klochok sushi. 
Stroyte poseleniya, dorogi i goroda, chtoby poluchit strategicheskoe preimushchestvo na ostrove CATAN! Nekotorykh resursov zdes v izobilii, a drugikh dnem s ognem ne syshchesh. 
Rasporyazhaytes resursami gramotno i dobeytes prevoskhodstva na ostrove CATAN! 

Igrayte v eksklyuzivnyy syuzhetnyy rezhim s mnogochislennymi stsenariyami, kazhdyy s unikalnymi startovymi usloviyami i tremya urovnyami slozhnosti.
Poluchite udovolstvie ot sovremennogo vzglyada na klassicheskuyu igru CATAN: vas zhdet tseloe raznoobrazie komponentov igry i stiley oformleniya.
Naslazhdaytes igroy kak doma na ekrane televizora, tak i na khodu.
Dopolnenie Morekhody vklyucheno! Otpravlyayte morskie ekspeditsii, chtoby kolonizirovat zhivopisnyy ostrov CATAN. Otkroyte neizvedannuyu zemlyu, a takzhe novye igrovye mekhaniki, vklyuchaya stroitelstvo korabley i protivostoyanie s piratami.  

Voznikli zatrudneniya? Nuzhna pomoshch? Pozhaluysta, svyazhites s nami: https://asmodee.helpshift.com/a/catan-switch/

zh_hans.title: Sam and Max 1: Save the World / 2 Beyond Time and Space / 3 The Devil's Playhouse (Season One, Two, Three) [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
zh_hans.voice_lang: 英语 + 俄语 来自 Russobit-M, 移植版 pashok6798 (primer ozvuchki) 用于 versii v589824 (1.0.9)
zh_hans.description:
«Sem i Maks spasayut mir», ili «Sam & Max: Season One» — seriya igr v zhanre kvest ot kompanii Telltale Games, osnovannaya na personazhakh komiksov khudozhnika Stiva Pyorsella. Kazhdyy epizod serii imeet samostoyatelnyy syuzhet, pri etom svyazannyy s sobytiyami drugikh epizodov.
Sam & Max Save the World teper podderzhivaet sootnoshenie storon 16: 9 i samoe vysokoe razreshenie, kotoroe pozvolyaet vashe oborudovanie. (Original byl 4:3 s maksimalnym razresheniem 1024x768!) V remastere dobavleno dinamicheskoe osveshchenie i uluchshena sinkhronizatsiya gub. Ves iskhodnyy zvuk igry, kotoryy byl bezumno szhat dlya sokhraneniya nebolshogo razmera zagruzki, byl pererabotan i perekodirovan iz iskhodnykh faylov s ispolzovaniem sovremennykh vysokokachestvennykh audiokodekov. Etot remaster vyglyadit, zvuchit i vosproizvoditsya kak igra, sozdannaya v 2020 godu, a ne v 2006.

zh_hans.title: Shin Megami Tensei III (SMT 3) Nocturne HD Remaster [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
Obychnyy den v Tokio obernulsya apokalipsisom, nachatym vnezemnymi silami. Ostatki mira pogruzilis v khaos, a v razrushennom gorode bushuet demonicheskaya revolyutsiya. Vy okazyvaetes v gushche srazheniya mezhdu bogami i demonami i mozhete reshat voprosy zhizni, pererozhdeniya i smerti, a takzhe povliyat na iskhod razvernuvsheysya bitvy.  

Eta znakovaya v svoem zhanre i neveroyatno slozhnaya rolevaya igra snova s nami i teper vklyuchaet: 

Obnovlennye trekhmernye modeli i fon
Dopolnitelnye nastroyki slozhnosti dlya igrokov s raznym urovnem masterstva 
Vozmozhnost sokhraneniya — sokhranyayte igru v lyuboe vremya!  
Professionalnaya ozvuchka — dostupny yaponskaya i angliyskaya versii

zh_hans.title: Maze [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
EXPLORE EVERY CORNER OF THE MAZE.
It feels like you really are the part of the Maze. Don't get tricked! Or the Maze will devour you and your fantasy adventure will be ended. Remember, do not be fooled by beauty and seductive scent. Everything here wants to kill you.

AVOID DANGEROUS TRAPS.
Have you ever thought about what rabbit feels locked in the trap? Be careful where you step and maybe you will live. Let this fantasy adventure conquer you.

MARVEL THE BEAUTY OF THE SURROUNDINGS AND ENVIRONMENT
Shining crystals, lush nature and fireflies. All of this and even more you will find in Maze game.

DON'T GET LOST - USE RUNES.
Do not rely solely on your desire to win, but keep your eyes wide open. Use tips and mark your path with runes. Follow the crumbs!

zh_hans.title: Inertial Drift + DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
zh_hans.description:
Inertial Drift — eto arkadnaya gonochnaya igra, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v retro-budushchem v stile devyanostykh. Unikalnaya model upravleniya i potryasayushchaya mekhanika gonok s parnymi stikami obyazatelno ponravitsya vsem igrokam. 

Inertial Drift vykhodit na novyy uroven dostupnosti i brosaet vyzov vsemu zhanru arkadnykh gonok. Eta igra unikalna i nichem ne napominaet drugie.

Unikalnoe upravlenie parnymi stikami dlya idealnogo vozhdeniya. Pravyy stik pozvolit vam polnostyu kontrolirovat avtomobil. Upravlenie intuitivno ponyatno novichkam i stanet priyatnym syurprizom dlya opytnykh igrokov. 

16 potryasayushchikh nepovtorimykh avtomobiley. Kazhdaya mashina — eto unikalnyy zver so svoimi kharakteristikami. Sadites za rul i popytaytes spravitsya so sportivnym khetchbekom, kupe, superkarom i mnozhestvom drugikh mashin!
 
20 slozhnykh trass. Nesites po ulitsam nochnogo goroda, gonyayte vokrug khramovykh kompleksov i nesites po uzkim gornym dorogam. 

Futuristicheskoe retro-budushchee v stile devyanostykh. Neobychnaya obstanovka: igrayte pod neonovo-rozovym zakatnym nebom i gonyayte v sumerkakh. 

Syuzhetnyy rezhim dlya odnogo igroka. Ottochite svoe iskusstvo vo vremya mnozhestva gonok, ispytaniy na vremya i demonstratsiy stilya!

Setevoy i lokalnyy M/P rezhim. Dumaete, chto net gonshchika luchshe vas? Proverte!

zh_hans.title: Touhou Project, 19 款游戏: Touhou Scarlet Curiosity, New World, Artificial Dream in Arcadia, Sky Arena Matsuri Climax, Hyouibana Antinomy, Wanderer Reloaded, Gensou Skydrift, Gensokyo, Azure Reflections, Kobuto V Burst Battle, Spell Bubble, Kubinashi Recollection i dr. [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description: Nastroytes na sovershenno novoe priklyuchenie s Reimu, Marisa, Sanae i eshche vashimi lyubimymi personazhami Touhou! Zemlya Gensokyo snova pogruzhaetsya vo tmu, kogda razvorachivaetsya novaya tayna. Kakie tayny zhdut v Tower of Desire?

zh_hans.title: Spirit Hunter: Death Mark + DLC Chapter 7 Kaerazu's Amusement Park [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description: Sobytiya Death Mark vrashchayutsya vokrug goroda En, zhiteli kotorogo v poslednee vremya stalkivayutsya so strannymi i, zachastuyu, neobyasnimymi yavleniyami. Odin za drugim oni stanovyatsya zhertvami nekoego proklyatiya, pod deystviem kotorogo obzavodyatsya shramami, pokhozhimi na ukus zverya, postepenno teryayut pamyat i, v konechnom schyote, umirayut. Imenno poetomu v narode eti shramy stali nazyvat «smertelnymi metkami».

zh_hans.title: Hatsune Miku Project DIVA Mega Mix + 26 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
Vpered, na stsenu! Znamenitaya ritm-igra vozvrashchaetsya v obnovlennom vide!

- Vybirayte odin iz dvukh rezhimov: traditsionnyy Arcade Mode (arkadnyy rezhim) s upravleniem knopkami ili novyy Mix Mode (smeshannyy rezhim), reagiruyushchiy na sensory dvizheniya. Vybirayte iz sta s lishnim pesen: ot lyubimoy fanatami klassiki do novykh khitov!
- Otsenite novuyu funktsiyu personalizatsii! Nadente odin iz trekh soten kostyumov ili sozdayte sobstvennuyu futbolku v redaktore futbolok!
- Sozdavayte pleylisty dlya svoikh lyubimykh klipov.

Ee muzyka obyazatelno ponravitsya vsem!

zh_hans.title: Another Life Adventure WorldNeverland: Daily life in the Elnea Kingdom + 152 DLC (WorNeva / World Neverland) [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
一款王國模擬遊戲，在這裡你可以移居到一個幻想中的王國，享受自由自在的生活。
這是一個讓你隨心所欲探索的奇幻虛擬王國…
穿越美麗的森林、河川、農場、牧場、礦場、學校、教堂和城堡。
但這還不是全部——王國居民的生活也被細緻地模擬了出來。

來到王國的玩家將會有如在玩一款真實的MMORPG，能夠與居民進行自然的對話互動。
你可以談戀愛、結婚、生兒育女…甚至連孩子也能有自己的孩子。
玩家在王國中所度過的每段人生都獨一無二，每一次遊玩都將是截然不同的體驗。
這不只是一般的遊戲——更是一段會永遠留在你心中的珍貴回憶。

zh_hans.title: Tools Up Ultimate edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
zh_hans.description:
《Tools Up!》終極版可以讓玩家體驗最完整最忙亂的《Tools Up！》遊戲包，包含遊戲本體，全部DLC和更新。

是時候改頭換面了。

帶上你的工具和安全帽，我們要做一些家庭改造。《Tools Up!》是一款緊張忙亂的本地合作遊戲，考驗你的裝修和團隊合作技能。在龐大的公寓大樓里，你要想方設法裝修越來越錯綜複雜的房子，以滿足租戶的各種要求，而這些要求往往都很奇怪。

最多可4人同時遊玩的本地多人合作遊戲

與最多4名好友一起遊玩，提高家庭裝修團隊的效率或者讓一切徹底亂套。注意：遊戲僅支援本地多人合作;不支援在線多人模式。遊戲可單人遊玩，但我們推薦與至少一位好友合作遊玩。

豐富的內容

這不是一項簡單的工作，所以我們帶來了一些專業人士。嗯，算是專業的吧。每個關卡都需要你處理大量的工作，而且不能弄得一團糟。在拆除人員完成工作后清掃垃圾、粉刷牆壁、鋪設瓷磚、粘貼牆紙，收取快遞、打掃衛生，而這才僅僅是開始。

競爭激烈的家庭改造：新的PvP模式

全新的玩家間對戰模式，讓你們的裝修團隊相互比拼！爭分奪秒完成盡可能多的任務，同時干擾其他團隊的每一步。各種遊戲玩法會讓所有人都全神貫注，且最多可支援4名玩家以各種組合進行遊戲，例如1v1、2v2、1v2v1、1v1v1、1v1v1v1等等。

戶外翻修：包含所有DLC

《Tools Up!》終極版包含《花園派對》DLC的全部45個關卡。全情投入春、夏、秋三個季節的關卡挑戰，讓你的戶外裝修團隊重建露台、種植樹木、修整草坪，並處理討厭的浣熊或鼴鼠。

每個以季節為主題的關卡包都有新的機制、設置和強大的終極BOSS戰！

zh_hans.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
zh_hans.description:
OB IGRE
Vy — Geralt iz Rivii, naemnyy ubiytsa chudovishch. Vy puteshestvuete po miru, v kotorom bushuet voyna i na kazhdom shagu podsteregayut chudovishcha. Vam predstoit vypolnit zakaz i nayti Tsiri — Ditya Prednaznacheniya, zhivoe oruzhie, sposobnoe izmenit oblik etogo mira.

Polnoe izdanie soderzhit osnovnuyu igru, gde vy mozhete nasladitsya ogromnym priklyucheniem v otkrytom mire na 100+ chasov, a takzhe syuzhetnye dopolneniya «Kamennye serdtsa» i «Krov i vino», rasschitannye eshchyo na 50 chasov igry.

V eto izdanie vkhodyat takzhe vse dopolnitelnye igrovye materialy, vklyuchaya novye predmety iz seriala «Vedmak» ot Netflix (oruzhie, dospekhi, kostyumy) i mnogoe drugoe!

IGRAYTE ZA PROFESSIONALNOGO UBIYTsU ChUDOVIShch
Vedmakov obuchayut s rannego detstva, i oni prokhodyat muchitelnye mutatsii, chtoby poluchit sverkhchelovecheskuyu silu i lovkost. Lyudi im ne doveryayut, no tolko oni stoyat mezhdu chelovechestvom i zhestokimi monstrami.
• Stante professionalnym okhotnikom na chudovishch, chtoby uchinit nad temi krovavuyu raspravu pri pomoshchi raznoobraznogo arsenala uluchshaemogo oruzhiya, alkhimicheskikh zeliy i boevoy magii.
• Vyslezhivayte mnozhestvo neobychnykh monstrov — ot dikikh zverey na gornykh perevalakh do zhutkikh sverkhestestvennykh khishchnikov v tyomnykh pereulkakh gustonaselyonnykh gorodov.
• Vkladyvayte zarabotok v uluchshenie oruzhiya i pokupku broni ili tranzhirte v raznykh zlachnykh mestakh, delaya stavki na skachkakh, igraya v karty i prinimaya uchastie v kulachnykh boyakh.

ISSLEDUYTE MORALNO NEODNOZNAChNYY OTKRYTYY MIR
«Vedmak 3» zadayot novye standarty razmera, glubiny i slozhnosti igrovogo mira.
• Stranstvuyte po fantasticheskomu otkrytomu miru: issleduyte drevnie razvaliny, peshchery i mesta korablekrusheniy, torguyte s kuptsami i krasnolyudskimi kuznetsami v gorodakh, lovite dobychu na otkrytykh ravninakh, v gorakh i na more.
• Zaklyuchayte sdelki s verolomnymi voenachalnikami, kovarnymi vedmami i prodazhnoy znatyu — i okazyvayte im tyomnye i opasnye uslugi.
• Delayte vybor na grani dobra i zla i nesite otvetstvennost za posledstviya.

zh_hans.title: Mistover + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description: 'MIST-ical' RPG with expeditions for finding the key to survival. Choose your next step wisely and keep in mind that your every move will change the future. Create your own 'Corps' and explore through various regions in the Pillar of Despair: forests, lakes, mountains, cities, cathedrals, castles, and much more.

zh_hans.title: River City Girls 1-2 / Zero / Melee Mach / Stay cool Kobayashi-san A River City Ransom Story / Rival Showdown [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
zh_hans.description:
There's trouble once again in River City! Picking up shortly after the original, River City Girls 2 puts players back in control of Misako and Kyoko - as well as Kunio, Riki, and newcomers Marian and Provie - as they set out on an all-new RPG-infused beat-'em-up adventure. New moves, new enemies, new recruits, new environments, new items, and the return of an old foe await, along with the same over-the-top sense of humor and adrenaline-pumping combat of its predecessor. The game will also feature multiple routes, a dynamic story system, and two-player co-op action.

"-Six playable characters, each with their own fighting styles and upgradable move sets!
-River City is bigger than ever! Explore all-new areas and branching paths!
-Play solo or team up with a friend, locally or online!
-Loads of new and returning NPCs to meet, interact with, and punch in the face!
-Anime intro, manga cutscenes, and an awesome soundtrack featuring RCG1 composer Megan McDuffy!"

zh_hans.title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Drum and Fun! + 316 DLC-pesen [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
Kultovaya muzykalnaya arkada iz Yaponii v vashem dome! Barabante ot vsey dushi, ispolzuya sensor dvizheniya!
 
• PERSONAZhI IZ LYuBIMYKh IGR I UNIKALNYE VNUTRIIGROVYE NAVYKI - Igrayte personazhami drugikh igr Nintendo i polzuytes ikh navykami!
 
• IGRA S SENSORAMI DVIZhENIYa - Igrayte na barabanakh v «arkadnom stile»!
 
• IGRA S DRUZYaMI - do 4 chelovek odnovremenno!
 
• LYuBIMAYa MUZYKA! 
 
• NOVYY REZhIM «KOMANDA» - V kotorom dostupna novaya slozhnost «ekspert»!

zh_hans.title: Mario plus Rabbids Kingdom Battle (Gold edition) [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 0]
zh_hans.description: 兩個世界在《瑪利歐 + 瘋狂兔子 王國之戰》裡撞出火花！

zh_hans.title: Deltarune: Chapter 1-2-3-4-5 [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + dva optsionalnykh perevoda: 1) 来自 Lenivoy Vykhukholi, nikthecat po pyatuyu glavu, 2) 来自 Cozy Inn, bez vtoroy glavy
zh_hans.description:
Sozdatel znamenitoy rolevoy igry UNDERTALE Tobi Foks vypuskaet prodolzhenie, odnako teper sobytiya razvorachivayutsya v sovershenno drugom mire. Predstavlyaem DELTARUNE Chapter 1! Sozdayte sobstvennogo geroya i pogruzites v mir tmy... pryamo seychas, ved pervyy epizod igry dostupen sovershenno besplatno!
Deltarune — nazvanie emblemy korolevskoy semi Drimurr iz originalnoy igry. Samo slovo — anagramma Undertale.Undertale i Undertale Yellow sm. zdes.

zh_hans.title: 上海 Refresh [NSZ][ENG]
zh_hans.description:
★不需要麻將知識，只要把花色相同的牌連在一起消除即可，規則超簡單！
★共有２５６面，份量感保證讓您滿意！
★利用首度搭載的配牌方式＜拖曳＞，盡情享受消牌的樂趣！
（當然也有傳統的點擊方式喔！）
★還搭載了電玩中心版「上海樂消麻將Ⅰ」、「上海樂消麻將Ⅱ」、「上海樂消麻將Ⅲ」的排列！
★可自由選擇難易度，進行遊戲！

遊戲系列首次以水為主題的上海樂消麻將，歡迎您來盡情煩惱，獲得療癒！

zh_hans.title: Don't Starve Together / Dont Starve: Nintendo Switch Edition + Hamlet DLC [NSZ][RUS (+Mod.)/Multi7]
zh_hans.interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7] + optsionalnyy lyubitelskiy 俄语 翻译 by djonmarvel (用于 v393216)
zh_hans.description:
走進一個充滿奇怪生物、危險和驚喜的陌生荒野世界。 收集資源來打造符合您生存風格的物品和結構。以自己的方式遊戲，揭開這片陌生土地的奧秘。

在私人遊戲中與您的好友合作，或在線與陌生人一起冒險。與其他玩家一起在惡劣環境中生存，或者獨自出擊。

盡一切努力，但最重要的是，Don't Starve。

zh_hans.title: Ice Age 2: The Meltdown (自制程序) [RUS]
zh_hans.description: 帮助受全球变暖驱使的各色动物到达陆地，在那里它们将不再受到无尽的危险的追捕。除了原有的游戏玩法之外，《The Meltdown》还提供了一系列不同的小游戏，可以丰富我们在虚拟世界中的时间并为孩子们带来乐趣。

zh_hans.title: NOX [NSP][RUS]
zh_hans.description:
用武力取胜、制服怪物或用魔法改变战斗进程 - 您会选择哪条路？常规滚地球击球手杰克·莫尔击中了诺克斯。这个世界仍然记得与死灵法师的战争，但它的捍卫者已经分裂，赫卡芭女王正在准备亡灵大军的回归。一个随机的外星人必须成为能够阻止她的英雄。
战士依靠重型盔甲、强大的武器和毁灭性的战斗技术。巫师征服动物和怪物，召唤魔法生物，派它们去狩猎或保护自己。魔术师拥有丰富的咒语库并能创造陷阱，每个陷阱最多可结合三个咒语。所选类别决定了最初的挑战、特殊任务和可用地点。后来，面对共同的威胁，英雄们的道路将会汇合，但熟悉的事件会以不同的方式出现，每条道路都会有自己的结局。
快速的战斗等待着您，准确性、移动性和力量组合将帮助您取得胜利，而一个错误可能会毁掉您。可视性系统 
TrueSight 将墙壁和角落后面的空间隐藏在阴影中：伏击可能正在最近的角落等待。对手捡起食物恢复生命值，受重伤后尝试逃跑，射手则保持距离并满怀期待地瞄准。利用您的环境来获胜。
通往胜利的三种道路，对同一个世界的三种看法——以及许多返回以不同方式经历一切的理由。

zh_hans.title: DuckTales: Remastered (移植版 ) [NRO][RUS]
zh_hans.description:
DuckTales: Remastered 是一款色彩缤纷的手绘重制版，改编自有史以来最受欢迎的 8 位游戏之一。重返视频游戏的黄金时代，但其细节水平将同样满足最热心的迪士尼粉丝和 Capcom 复古游戏粉丝的需求。手绘动画角色，由迪士尼演员的知名声音配音，以及受经典电视卡通启发的详细关卡背景，使史克鲁奇·麦克老鸭和他的家人比以往任何时候都更加生动。
游戏玩法保留了其 8 位前身的真实性：仍然简单有趣，只是进行了一些细微的更改以改进游戏玩法和图形。与史克鲁奇·麦克老鸭和他的三个侄子一起进入 DuckTales 的冒险世界，比利、威利和迪利穿越异域风情，寻找五件传奇宝藏。

zh_hans.title: Survival Crisis Z (自制程序)
zh_hans.description: 《生存危机 Z》的原生移植版。一款以自上而下视角讲述僵尸的游戏。你穿过被感染的建筑物，收集物资，制作设备并尝试生存。

zh_hans.title: Super Mario World (移植版 ) [EN]
zh_hans.description:
《超级马里奥世界》是任天堂于 1990 年为 SNES 发布的平台游戏。该游戏是在宫本茂和手冢隆的指导下开发的。
在故事中，马里奥和路易吉去恐龙之地度假，库巴在那里绑架了碧琪公主。兄弟俩遇到了恐龙耀西，他的朋友也被抓走了。他们一起出发去拯救公主和恐龙，穿越七个世界并与头目战斗。
耀西首次出现在游戏中，成为该系列的主角之一。 《超级马里奥世界》广受好评，成为最畅销的 SNES 游戏，全球销量超过 2000 万份。
